changelog.text: Auspex Sports goes live: NHL moneylines and NBA player props, every pick posted before the game. The live record starts here; earlier test picks were cleared.
NBA props model rebuilt for live use and blended with the market price: +7.4% on 617 unseen 2025-26 bets at the best price, flat 1-unit stakes.
NBA spreads, totals and moneylines tested with neural nets, Bayesian models and Monte Carlo simulation. No edge after the vig, so they are not published.
NHL moneyline model goes into live testing, picks locked before the first puck drop and graded at the locked price.
